name: Diagnostic Usage & Time-Window Monitor
description: Monitors system/process resource spikes, correlates application crash/hang events, and tracks active foreground window transitions during user-defined diagnostic timeframes.

subComponents.name: System & Per-Process Resource Spikes
subComponents.description: Captures CPU %, RAM working set, Disk I/O, and Network throughput spikes.

subComponents.name: Application Crash & Hang Event Correlator
subComponents.description: Correlates resource spikes with Event ID 1000/1002 application faults in the same window.

subComponents.name: Foreground Window & Problem App Tracker
subComponents.description: Logs active foreground process transitions when UI stalls or slowdowns occur.

tools.name: Configure Diagnostic Watch Window
tools.description: Schedules a timeframe and resource threshold watch for problematic applications.

tools.name: Capture Correlated Diagnostic Clues
tools.description: Collects telemetry across enabled sub-components (Resource Spikes, Crash Correlator, Active Window) for the active watch window.

tools.name: Synthesize Diagnostic Clues with AI
tools.description: Sends correlated resource spikes and crash events to the Central LLM Service to pinpoint root causes.

tools.name: Purge Rolling Telemetry Database
tools.description: Deletes stored diagnostic snapshots from the portable ./data directory.
